title: Open temperature reference datasets: oven conversions (gas mark / fan), safe internal cooking temperatures, body temperature thresholds
description:
Machine-readable temperature reference tables with row-level provenance.

  • human-body-temperature: 34 rows, version 1.0.0, last checked 2026-08-27 (JSON / CSV)
  • oven-conversions: 12 rows, version 1.0.0, last checked 2026-08-27 (JSON / CSV)
  • safe-internal-temperatures: 9 rows, version 1.0.0, last checked 2026-08-27 (JSON / CSV)

Every row states the publishing body, the URL it was read from, a verbatim fragment of the source text, and the date it was checked. Where authorities disagree, both figures are kept and labelled rather than averaged; bands that no authority publishes are absent.

This repository mirrors the published layer at https://ctofconverter.com/data/ and is kept in sync by CI. Data CC-BY-4.0, code MIT.
